name: io.github.DidroAI/sap-ui-automation
title: SAP UI Automation
description: Let agents see and drive your open SAP screens: SAP GUI, Web GUI, Fiori. Writes wait for your yes.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Actions that may save, post or delete: confirm (each waits for your yes in the client; the default), off (read-only: refused) or on.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_ALLOW_SYSTEMS
environmentVariables.description: The only systems the server may touch, e.g. QAS or QAS/100, comma-separated. Empty: every system.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_ALLOW_TCODES
environmentVariables.description: The only transactions and Fiori apps the agent may open, comma-separated (VA03, SalesOrder-manage). Empty: all but the blocked ones.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_BLOCK_TCODES
environmentVariables.description: Transactions and Fiori apps the agent may never open, comma-separated (SE38, SM30).
